digest.component_or_area: ticket store, optimistic concurrency, sidecar event reconciliation
propositions: A description edit was verified at 14,997 chars but a subsequent read returned 10,582 chars (older revision) with no error reported; the write appeared successful then silently reverted.
Optimistic concurrency failed to reject a losing concurrent write; the documented protection is a ConcurrencyError on conflict, but the write succeeded and was silently rolled back afterwards.

A write to a ticket while its own plan-review was in flight (emitting REVIEW_RESULT sidecar events) may trigger store reconvergence that silently discards the newer local write in favor of stale inbound state.
A later write to the same ticket with no review in flight remained intact, suggesting the in-flight review is the trigger for the silent reversion.
Read-back verification passed despite the data being lost afterwards, invalidating the standard agent mitigation.
